Name: Kitchen Nook for 1st Farmhouse
Author: Allayna
Description:
Adds a small functional kitchen area to the starting farmhouse. Now you can cook without paying and waiting for your first house upgrade!
You cannot change the wallpaper or flooring in there, sorry. (If someone could tell me how, that would be awesome!)
You install this by either replacing the vanilla farmhouse.xnb, or by using xnb loader.
As seen in the screenshots, it will work with altered versions of the farmhousetiles and towninterior

Downloads.Description: Fixed walls and floors, fixed missing table message
